data.title: Technology — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: technology
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey, hey, we're at a party!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
The power outlet… El enchufe  
Come on, let's celebrate… Vamos a celebrar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
We're dancing like stars.

[Verse]
Balloons flying, music loud,  
The chip… El chip is in the game.  
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños  
We're singing your name.  
The battery… La batería  
Keeps us on the move.  
The speaker… El altavoz  
Makes the vibe groove.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
The power outlet… El enchufe  
Come on, let's celebrate… Vamos a celebrar  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  
We're dancing like stars.

[Verse]
The sensor… El sensor  
Feels the beat in the air.  
The button… El botón  
Lights up everywhere.  
The antenna… La antena  
Reaches for the sky.  
The cable… El cable  
Connects you and I.

[Bridge]
Remember the password… La contraseña  
To the fun we share.  
The camera… La cámara  
Captures moments rare.  
We're tech and tunes,  
Together in this room.  
With every step,
